# Nick Jonsson

> Global keynote speaker, executive coach, counsellor and psychotherapist based in Singapore. TEDx speaker and international bestselling author of Executive Loneliness. Ranked #28 among the Global Gurus Top 30 Coaching Professionals in 2026. Host of The Limitless Podcast (300+ episodes). Creator of the 5 Steps to Holistic Leadership (Surrender, Purpose, Connection, Goals, Discipline). Signed with A-Speakers.

## Topics
Executive loneliness; burnout to breakthrough; the 5 Steps to Holistic Leadership; psychological safety and high-performing teams in the AI era; resilience (IRONMAN All-World Athlete).

## Formats
International keynotes, corporate workshops, leadership masterclasses, panel discussions. Languages: English, Swedish.

## Recent stages
SHE LEADS and HE LEADS 2026, Kuala Lumpur (Nov 2026); 4th International Conference on Neurology and Neurological Disorders, Paris (Oct 2026, keynote); Global Conference on Addiction and Psychiatry, London (Aug 2026, keynote); CIO100 Awards and Conference India; National Counselling and Psychotherapy Conference Singapore.
